description.en:
MagicBot Z1 is MagicLab's smaller humanoid platform for agile motion and developer experimentation. The design emphasizes broad joint travel, dynamic balance and recovery, with learning-based control used to develop humanlike whole-body movements.

MagicLab provides open interfaces and development resources for controlling the robot and extending its behavior. The platform combines multiple sensor types for surrounding perception, with navigation and obstacle-avoidance functions described as part of its software capabilities. Z1 is positioned as a compact system for exploring movement, interaction and embodied intelligence. Demonstrated motions and learning claims should be interpreted according to their training setup and operating conditions.
